all_pending.title: Replace fixed R&D cadence with event-triggered research cycles
all_pending.description: R&D last ran 86h ago and fires on a fixed 3-day clock. Markets don't care about our schedule. High-conviction opportunities emerge after earnings beats, sector breakouts, and macro prints — not on a Tuesday-every-three-days basis. Proposal: keep the 3-day heartbeat, but add event triggers: any sector ETF moving >3% in a day forces an immediate targeted R&D cycle for that sector only. Canary YELLOW triggers a full cycle. This would have caught the DIS move that fired ORANGE today.
all_pending.evidence: last_research_run: 2026-06-08 (86h ago). Canary fired 105 alert(s) today without fresh research.
all_pending.proposed_fix: In canary_agent.py: when a sector ETF moves >3% intraday, write `data/rd_trigger.json` with the sector name. In main.py Step 3c: if rd_trigger.json exists and is <4h old, run rd_team_leader.py --sector <name> regardless of 3-day cadence. Delete the trigger file after the cycle completes.

think_tank.title: Add a regime-adaptive strategy layer: momentum → defensive factor rotation
think_tank.description: The firm runs a pure momentum strategy in all market conditions. CRO is currently CRITICAL and the canary fired ORANGE 2× today. In CRITICAL/HIGH regimes, momentum names are systematically the hardest hit — we're fighting the market instead of adapting to it. A regime layer would detect the risk environment from canary + CRO signals and auto-rotate the research mandate: in GREEN regimes, pursue momentum; in ORANGE/CRITICAL, mandate defensive picks (low-beta, dividend yield, quality factor) and reduce position sizing. This doesn't require a new strategy — it's a wrapper around the existing one.
think_tank.evidence: CRO level: CRITICAL | Canary alerts today: 2 | Current portfolio down from start; all buys blocked for extended period.
think_tank.proposed_fix: Add `regime` field to canary_state.json (BULL/NEUTRAL/DEFENSIVE/CRISIS). R&D leader reads regime at assignment time and shifts sector scoring weights: in DEFENSIVE mode, boost low-volatility and dividend sectors; in CRISIS, assign only capital-preservation mandates. Manager Agent adjusts MAX_POSITION_SIZE_PCT down 30% in DEFENSIVE mode.

think_tank.title: Replace flat position sizing with conviction-weighted Kelly-derived sizing
think_tank.description: All approved picks receive the same capital allocation regardless of conviction score (3★ vs 5★ get identical sizing). This treats a high-conviction thesis identically to a marginal one, compressing returns. A Kelly-fraction approach — sizing proportional to edge estimate derived from conviction score, historical approval rate per agent, and sector momentum score — would concentrate capital in the firm's best ideas and reduce it in weaker ones. Even a half-Kelly implementation would improve capital efficiency.
think_tank.evidence: buy_log has 20 entries; all use flat MAX_POSITION_SIZE_PCT with no conviction modifier.
think_tank.proposed_fix: In manager_agent.py: at BUY execution, compute `size_multiplier = 0.5 + (conviction - 3) * 0.25` for conviction 3–5. Multiply MAX_POSITION_SIZE_PCT by this factor (floor 0.5×, ceiling 1.5×). Log `conviction_size_multiplier` in buy_log for post-trade attribution.

think_tank.title: Build a targeted short book for CRITICAL/HIGH risk regimes
think_tank.description: In CRITICAL risk regimes (current: CRITICAL), the firm deploys SH as a broad inverse hedge. SH tracks the S&P 500 inverse — it captures index-level moves but misses the outsized drawdowns in weakest names. Proposal: when CRO declares CRITICAL, the R&D leader runs a 'short scan' pass alongside the normal long scan, looking for names with: deteriorating fundamentals, failed support levels, high short interest already, and negative sector momentum. These enter a separate 'short book' with its own position limits and stop-loss rules (inverted: stop-gain not stop-loss).
think_tank.evidence: CRO level: CRITICAL. SH is current only short vehicle. Individual name shorts in CRITICAL regime could 3-5× the hedge alpha vs. index-level SH.
think_tank.proposed_fix: Add `short_book_enabled` flag to config.py, gated on CRO level. R&D leader gets a `--scan-shorts` mode that inverts scoring criteria. Manager Agent executes short sells via Alpaca (supported in paper mode). Separate MAX_SHORT_POSITION_PCT (suggest 3%) and SHORT_STOP_GAIN_PCT (15%).
